design_revision: The declaration moves only when no reader wants the other sign (the first version took a net vote, which left the merged variable unsigned under an int declaration for a slot stored from a register and printed its unsigned readers uncast); reconcile re-checks the merged variable at the head of ActionSetCasts and restores the variable's type when a member's reader disagrees; a slot the layout would stretch into an array declines; the walk stops at another stack slot.
